rawInput:
Welcome back to the Future of Technology podcast. Today, we're exploring how AI agents are changing the way businesses operate. Unlike traditional chatbots, AI agents can plan tasks, use tools, analyze information, and take action with minimal human intervention.

Imagine a marketing team that can automatically research competitors, draft campaign ideas, prepare social media posts, and analyze performance reports. Humans still provide direction and oversight, but repetitive work becomes faster.

The real challenge isn't simply building smarter AI. It's creating reliable systems that are transparent, secure, and genuinely useful. In the next five years, the companies that succeed will be those that combine human creativity with responsible AI automation.
